title.zh: 触发机理：高电场总会寻找弱点
title.en: Trigger mechanisms: high fields find weak points

subtitle.zh: 充电/ 异常间隙/导电搭桥 /绝缘退化
subtitle.en: Charging / abnormal gaps / conductive bridges / insulation degradation

body.zh: 充电/ 异常间隙/导电搭桥 /绝缘退化
body.en: Charging / abnormal gaps / conductive bridges / insulation degradation
Backside particles, bow or de-chuck gap

body.zh: • Wafer Bow 导致局部间隙

body.en: Edge / ring deposition or conductive residue bridging
Ground, insulator, ESC or match anomaly

body.zh: 触发条件并非固定单一根因，
body.en: Triggers need not have a single fixed root cause;

body.zh: 可能同时并存或交互放大
body.en: they may coexist or amplify one another

body.zh: 更强Power或Bias可能提升工艺能力，但会压缩绝缘和异常间隙容限
body.en: Higher power or bias can improve process capability but reduces tolerance to insulation weaknesses and abnormal gaps

body.zh: 在性能提升与绝缘裕度之间取得平衡，避免触发Arcing风险
body.en: Balance performance gains against insulation margin to avoid arcing

body.zh: 量测反馈：He Leak与Pressure / Wafer Bow / ESC电流 / RF Match与PM状态
body.en: Measurement feedback: He leak / pressure / wafer bow / ESC current / RF match and PM state

body.zh: 可能造成温控失稳、De-chuck、膜层破坏和硬件损伤
body.en: May destabilize temperature control, de-chuck, damage films and hardware

body.zh: 上述是根因分类，不代表每次Arcing都由颗粒或De-chuck造成
body.en: These are root-cause categories; not every arcing event is caused by particles or de-chuck
